# anyscale_role_binding_policy (Resource)

~> **Beta.** Role bindings are enabled per organization by Anyscale while customers migrate; contact [support@anyscale.com](mailto:support@anyscale.com) to enable them. Breaking schema changes get a deprecation first and a changelog entry. See the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md#role-bindings-beta).

Manages every direct role binding on one organization, cloud or project. Authoritative: an apply revokes any direct binding on the scope that `roles` does not name, including ones Anyscale grants itself, such as a project or cloud creator's owner binding. Bindings held on a parent scope are not affected. Never combine it with `anyscale_role_binding` or `anyscale role-binding policy apply` on the same scope: each revokes what the other grants. Destroy revokes every binding the API allows, keeping the provider identity's own and any frozen binding. Requires an organization [converted to role bindings](../guides/rbac.md#organization-access-mode).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Beta; Anyscale enables it per organization (contact
# support@anyscale.com). AUTHORITATIVE: every direct role binding on
# the scope that roles does not name is revoked, including the owner
# binding Anyscale grants whoever created the project. Do not also
# manage this scope with anyscale_role_binding.
variable "project_id" {
  description = "ID of an existing Anyscale project (prj_...)"
  type        = string
}

# Exact, case-sensitive role names; they can differ per environment.
data "anyscale_role" "project_owner" {
  name = "Project owner"
}

data "anyscale_role" "project_reader" {
  name = "Project reader"
}

# The identity Terraform runs as.
data "anyscale_user" "me" {}

resource "anyscale_user_group" "analysts" {
  name = "analysts"
}

resource "anyscale_role_binding_policy" "project" {
  # exactly one of organization_id, cloud_id, project_id
  project_id = var.project_id

  roles = {
    # Keep this identity's own owner binding: the API refuses to
    # revoke it, and an identity cannot grant itself a role.
    (data.anyscale_role.project_owner.id) = {
      user_ids = [data.anyscale_user.me.id]
    }
    (data.anyscale_role.project_reader.id) = {
      user_group_ids = [anyscale_user_group.analysts.id]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `roles` (Attributes Map) Every direct binding on the scope, keyed by role ID (`rol_...`; look one up with the `anyscale_role` data source). `{}` revokes every binding the API allows. The API refuses to revoke the provider identity's own binding, so name it to keep it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

### Optional

- `cloud_id` (String) Manage the bindings on this cloud. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the policy.
- `organization_id` (String) Manage the bindings on the organization: the token's own, as returned by the `anyscale_organization` data source. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the policy.
- `project_id` (String) Manage the bindings on this project. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`. Changing it replaces the policy.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<scope_type>/<scope_id>`, for example `project/prj_...`.

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Optional:

- `user_group_ids` (Set of String) User groups (`ug_...`) that hold the role. Set at least one of `user_ids` or `user_group_ids`.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) Users (`usr_...`) that hold the role. Set at least one of `user_ids` or `user_group_ids`. The provider identity can keep a role it holds but cannot grant itself one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by scope: <scope_type>/<scope_id>, where scope_type is
# organization, cloud or project. Read fills roles from the API.
terraform import anyscale_role_binding_policy.project project/prj_abc123
```
